electronic_state: broken-symmetry unrestricted open-shell singlet (BS-UDFT); do not model as a closed-shell singlet or a doublet

force_model.name: terminal tensile force
force_model.direction_convention: apply equal and opposite tensile forces to the centers of the two terminal methyl groups along their instantaneous connecting axis; report the implementation and any projection/constrained-coordinate approximation
force_model.thermal_channel: remove the external force and reoptimize the same isotactic radical model before searching the thermal pathway

source: supplementary_001.pdf pp. 11, 16, 23-25; force-labeled structures are printed with 0 1 and the methods specify unrestricted DFT/open-shell singlets
